title: Package title (optional)
deleteConfirm: Delete the remaining proposals in this package? Accepted changes stay in the project.
originGone: Original project no longer listed - the kept draft stays here until you send or discard it
sourceBlocked: Finish the proposal or review mode before changing the saved project directly.
fileAbsent: This file does not exist in this view.
sourceConflict: The same passage was changed in the original. Your draft has been kept; align the conflicting passage before sending again.
acceptRelated: This change needs related changes. Accept them together? Independent proposals will stay pending.
acceptAction: Accept file action (keep content edits pending)
staleChange: This change no longer fits the current text, so nothing was applied. Correct it or discard it.
sendNeedsChange: Change the text before sending suggestions.
discardConfirm: Discard all unsent changes and comments?
